sys_script_fix.description: Seeds/restores PTAG scoring model v1 (19 rows: 15 weights, 3 bands, 1 gate). Idempotent - safe to run repeatedly.
sys_script_fix.name: PTAG Hub - Seed scoring model v1
sys_script_fix.script: /* PTAG Hub - Seed scoring model v1 (I7). Idempotent: keyed on row_type + signal + signal_value + scoring_version. - identical row -> untouched; drifted row -> restored; missing -> inserted. setWorkflow(false): seeding defines model v1 - it must not fire the weight-change tuning BR (version bump + debounced rescore) per row. Ends with one explicit rescoreOpen() so any open records pick up the model. App-repo note (blueprint): data rows do not travel with app-repo deploys; this Fix Script is the sanctioned carrier for the v1 seed. */ (function seedScoringModelV1() { var T = 'x_snc_ptag_engage_scoring_weight'; var SEED = [ { "row_type": "weight", "category": "viability", "rule": "boolean_true", "signal": "business_owner", "signal_value": "", "weight": 10, "label": "Business owner identified", "tmin": "", "tmax": "", "band": "", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "" }, { "row_type": "weight", "category": "viability", "rule": "boolean_true", "signal": "executive_sponsor", "signal_value": "", "weight": 10, "label": "Executive sponsor", "tmin": "", "tmax": "", "band": "", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "" }, { "row_type": "weight", "category": "viability", "rule": "boolean_true", "signal": "corporate_alignment", "signal_value": "", "weight": 10, "label": "Corporate goal / big-bet alignment", "tmin": "", "tmax": "", "band": "", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "" }, { "row_type": "weight", "category": "viability", "rule": "boolean_true", "signal": "budget", "signal_value": "", "weight": 10, "label": "Budget identified", "tmin": "", "tmax": "", "band": "", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "" }, { "row_type": "weight", "category": "desirability", "rule": "boolean_true", "signal": "pipeline", "signal_value": "", "weight": 15, "label": "Partner pipeline", "tmin": "", "tmax": "", "band": "", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "" }, { "row_type": "weight", "category": "desirability", "rule": "numeric_band", "signal": "tam", "signal_value": "gte_50m", "weight": 15, "label": "TAM >= $50M", "tmin": 50000000, "tmax": "", "band": "", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "" }, { "row_type": "weight", "category": "desirability", "rule": "numeric_band", "signal": "tam", "signal_value": "gte_10m", "weight": 10, "label": "TAM >= $10M", "tmin": 10000000, "tmax": "", "band": "", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "" }, { "row_type": "weight", "category": "desirability", "rule": "numeric_band", "signal": "tam", "signal_value": "gte_1m", "weight": 5, "label": "TAM >= $1M", "tmin": 1000000, "tmax": "", "band": "", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "" }, { "row_type": "weight", "category": "desirability", "rule": "all_nonempty", "signal": "customer_pain_points,value_prop", "signal_value": "", "weight": 5, "label": "Pain points + value proposition narratives", "tmin": "", "tmax": "", "band": "", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "" }, { "row_type": "weight", "category": "feasibility", "rule": "value_match", "signal": "in_market_status", "signal_value": "Idea", "weight": 4, "label": "Maturity: Idea", "tmin": "", "tmax": "", "band": "", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "" }, { "row_type": "weight", "category": "feasibility", "rule": "value_match", "signal": "in_market_status", "signal_value": "prototype", "weight": 8, "label": "Maturity: Prototype", "tmin": "", "tmax": "", "band": "", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "" }, { "row_type": "weight", "category": "feasibility", "rule": "value_match", "signal": "in_market_status", "signal_value": "pilot", "weight": 12, "label": "Maturity: Pilot", "tmin": "", "tmax": "", "band": "", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "" }, { "row_type": "weight", "category": "feasibility", "rule": "value_match", "signal": "in_market_status", "signal_value": "in_market", "weight": 16, "label": "Maturity: In Market", "tmin": "", "tmax": "", "band": "", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "" }, { "row_type": "weight", "category": "feasibility", "rule": "value_match", "signal": "in_market_status", "signal_value": "ready_for_sale", "weight": 20, "label": "Maturity: Ready For Sale", "tmin": "", "tmax": "", "band": "", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "" }, { "row_type": "weight", "category": "feasibility", "rule": "boolean_true", "signal": "certified_resources", "signal_value": "", "weight": 5, "label": "Certified resources", "tmin": "", "tmax": "", "band": "", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "" }, { "row_type": "band", "category": "", "rule": "", "signal": "score_band", "signal_value": "fast_track", "weight": "", "label": "Fast Track: score 70-100", "tmin": 70, "tmax": 100, "band": "fast_track", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "" }, { "row_type": "band", "category": "", "rule": "", "signal": "score_band", "signal_value": "standard", "weight": "", "label": "Standard: score 40-69", "tmin": 40, "tmax": 69, "band": "standard", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "" }, { "row_type": "band", "category": "", "rule": "", "signal": "score_band", "signal_value": "needs_development", "weight": "", "label": "Needs Development: score 0-39", "tmin": 0, "tmax": 39, "band": "needs_development", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "" }, { "row_type": "gate", "category": "", "rule": "all_false", "signal": "executive_sponsor,budget", "signal_value": "", "weight": "", "label": "No executive sponsor and no budget caps the band at Standard", "tmin": "", "tmax": "", "band": "standard", "scoring_version": 1, "active": true, "notes": "Hard gate: a request with neither an executive sponsor nor budget cannot band above Standard regardless of raw score." } ]; var ins = 0, upd = 0, same = 0; for (var i = 0; i < SEED.length; i++) { var r = SEED[i]; var gr = new GlideRecord(T); gr.addQuery('row_type', r.row_type); gr.addQuery('signal', r.signal); gr.addQuery('signal_value', r.signal_value); gr.addQuery('scoring_version', r.scoring_version); gr.query(); var fields = ['label', 'category', 'rule', 'weight', 'threshold_min', 'threshold_max', 'band', 'active', 'notes']; var vals = {label: r.label, category: r.category, rule: r.rule, weight: r.weight, threshold_min: r.tmin, threshold_max: r.tmax, band: r.band, active: r.active, notes: r.notes}; if (gr.next()) { var drift = false; for (var f = 0; f < fields.length; f++) { var want = String(vals[fields[f]] === null || vals[fields[f]] === undefined ? '' : vals[fields[f]]); var got = String(gr.getValue(fields[f]) === null ? '' : gr.getValue(fields[f])); if (fields[f] === 'active') { got = String(gr.getElement('active')); } if (got !== want) { drift = true; break; } } if (!drift) { same++; continue; } gr.setWorkflow(false); for (var f2 = 0; f2 < fields.length; f2++) gr.setValue(fields[f2], vals[fields[f2]]); gr.update(); upd++; } else { var n = new GlideRecord(T); n.newRecord(); n.setWorkflow(false); n.setValue('row_type', r.row_type); n.setValue('signal', r.signal); n.setValue('signal_value', r.signal_value); n.setValue('scoring_version', r.scoring_version); for (var f3 = 0; f3 < fields.length; f3++) n.setValue(fields[f3], vals[fields[f3]]); n.insert(); ins++; } } var cnt = new GlideAggregate(T); cnt.addAggregate('COUNT'); cnt.query(); var total = cnt.next() ? cnt.getAggregate('COUNT') : '?'; gs.info('[PTAG seed v1] inserted=' + ins + ' restored=' + upd + ' unchanged=' + same + ' total_rows=' + total); new x_snc_ptag_engage.PTAGScoringEngine().rescoreOpen('post-seed'); })();
sys_script_fix.sys_name: PTAG Hub - Seed scoring model v1
